title: Dacon
summary: A personal collection of notebooks documenting a Korean data scientist's competition entries (Dacon challenges), including financial and biological AI competitions. Several notebooks use SDV's CTGANSynthesizer and TVAESynthesizer via the sdv.single_table module to generate synthetic tabular data for data augmentation, along with sdv.evaluation.single_table's run_diagnostic and evaluate_quality to assess it.
